With the foundation (header parsing, CRC64 key derivation, XOR de-scrambling, and `.DAT` framing) verified and audited in Phase 1, Phase 2 implements the actual flight data extraction—turning raw scrambled payload bytes into structured, physically calibrated telemetry (GPS coordinates, altitude, battery cells, attitude, RC sticks) and handling modern v13/v14 AES-256 continuous IV chaining.

```markdown
## Requirements

### R1. Record Stream Demuxer & Record Envelope Parser
- Implement the streaming record splitter in `crates/flightreader-core/src/txt/record.rs`:
  - Read `record_type` (u8) and `length` (encoded as u8 for v1–v6 or u16 LE for v7–v14).
  - Extract payload slices and adva

and the ciphertext of the final 16-byte block of record N becomes the initialization vector (IV) for record N+1.
- Support slice decryption with padding validation and integrity bounds.

### R4. Geodetic Coordinate & Elevation Mathematics (Section 7 of SPECS.md)
Implement geodetic conversions in `crates/flightreader-core/src/geo/`:
- WGS84 ellipsoidal to EGM2008 MSL orthometric height calculation ($H = h - N$).
- Compact bilinear interpolation table lookup for the EGM2008 geoid undulation model.
- Coordinate distance, bearing, and trajectory point math.

### R5. Core DJI .DAT Telemetry Decoders
Implement key blackbox payload decoders in `crates/flightreader-core/src/dat/records/`:
- IMU raw acceleration and gyro rates.
- Motor speed diagnostics and PWM duty cycles.
- Battery pack diagnostic streams.

### R6. Comprehensive Unit, Integration, and Differential Tests
Deliver an exhaustive test suite:
- Unit tests verifying bit-exact field parsing against reference hex vectors from SPECS.md and `tests/empirical/`.
- Differential cross-language tests validating that decoded telemetry matches the outputs of the decompiled C# routines.
- Fuzz tests verifying that truncated or malformed records fail gracefully with typed `FlightReaderError` without panicking.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All code strictly adheres to `#![deny(unsafe_code)]` with zero `unsafe` blocks.
- [ ] Zero stubs, `todo!()`, or `unimplemented!()` in core decoding routines.
- [ ] Decoded physical units (coordinates, altitudes, speeds, temperatures, voltages) exactly match unit conversions defined in SPECS.md.
- [ ] `cargo check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, and `cargo test --all` pass cleanly with 100% pass rate.
```
